# Quote

<TierBadge tier="professional" />

Fetch every option contract's 1-minute NBBO quote intervals for one date: one row per minute in which a new quote was reported. The vendor keeps the most recent 7 calendar days.

<RequestBuilder :cfg="cfg" />

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `date` | date | yes | - | Date YYYYMMDD |
| `timeout_ms` | int | no | - | Per-request deadline in milliseconds. 0 means no deadline. |

## Response

Rows of `IntervalQuoteTick`:

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `interval_ms_of_day` | i32 | Time of the interval the row samples, milliseconds since midnight ET. |
| `quote_ms_of_day` | i32 | Time the quote in effect at the interval was reported, milliseconds since midnight ET. |
| `bid_size` | i32 | NBBO bid size. |
| `bid_exchange` | i32 | Exchange code of the NBBO bid. Zero is a code the vendor assigns a meaning, so read `columns()` to tell a reported zero from a response that carried no such column. |
| `bid` | f64 | NBBO bid price. |
| `bid_condition` | i32 | Quote condition code on the bid side. Zero is a code the vendor assigns a meaning, so read `columns()` to tell a reported zero from a response that carried no such column. |
| `ask_size` | i32 | NBBO ask size. |
| `ask_exchange` | i32 | Exchange code of the NBBO ask. Zero is a code the vendor assigns a meaning, so read `columns()` to tell a reported zero from a response that carried no such column. |
| `ask` | f64 | NBBO ask price. |
| `ask_condition` | i32 | Quote condition code on the ask side. Zero is a code the vendor assigns a meaning, so read `columns()` to tell a reported zero from a response that carried no such column. |
| `date` | i32 | Trading date as a YYYYMMDD integer. |

Every row carries `expiration` (YYYYMMDD), `strike` (dollars) and `right` ("C" / "P"); with the row's root, which the whole result carries per row, they identify the contract.
